Legacy 201 Emerald Beach by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Legacy 201, a beautiful 4 bedroom, 3 bath beach-front condo in picturesque Seagrove Beach. The Legacy community is abundant with amenities, with two community pools, one of them beachfront. It’s a bit difficult describing the gorgeous newly renovated interiors, and new furniture, without first acknowledging the incredible windows highlighting the Gulf! The breathtaking views can be enjoyed from the open living area and kitchen, as well as the primary bedroom and the large balcony. Nice! The primary suite, king, features an attached bathroom, while the additional bedrooms offer a variety of sleeping arrangements to accommodate your group. Two bedrooms feature queen-size beds, one shares a Jack and Jill bathroom.

The fourth bedroom has four twin bunks and one twin trundle. The Legacy is a gated community with private beach access that's just a short walk from the condo, which includes an elevator. You'll also be close to a convenience store, and 4-star dining, as well as casual eateries. You'll love Cafe Thirty-A, Angelina's Pizzeria and Pasta, Mi Casita Mexican Grill, and Under The Sea Ice Cream. And Seaside? It’s just a short bike ride away! Experience 30A in style and comfort. And let Legacy 201 be your perfect Emerald Coast getaway. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gulf-front - 50 steps to beach (private access) - Complimentary beach service (March 1st - October 31st) - 4 bedrooms, 3 baths - 2,290 sq ft - Community gulf-front pool - Parking is limited to 2 vehicles (vehicle information required) - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; jetted tub bath; TV - Queen in guest room; shared hall bath - Queen in guest room; Jack and Jill bath - 2 twin/twin bunk beds and 1 twin trundle; Jack and Jill bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
